title: A Label Noise Robust Algorithm for Graph Data using Neighborhood Label Distribution
abstract: arXiv:2610.22998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have demonstrated exceptional performance on graph-structured data. However, their success heavily relies on the availability of clean labels, an assumption that often fails in real-world scenarios. The learnability of GCNs is intrinsically linked to the neighborhood structure of nodes, making it critical to understand how this structure changes in the presence of label noise. In this work, we investigate how the neighborhood label distribution of a node changes under label noise. We mathematically derive that label noise smooths this distribution, which inherently increases its entropy and severely decreases interclass distinguishability. To address this challenge, we propose Leave-one-out Entropy Node Screening (LENS), an end-to-end framework that identifies noisy nodes by measuring the reduction in neighborhood entropy when a specific node is removed. translated_title: 一种基于邻域标签分布的图数据标签噪声鲁棒算法
translated_abstract: 图卷积网络（GCNs）在图结构数据上展现了卓越的性能。然而，其成功在很大程度上依赖于干净标签的可获得性，而这一假设在现实场景中往往不成立。GCNs的可学习性与节点的邻域结构有着内在联系，因此理解该结构在标签噪声存在下如何变化至关重要。在这项工作中，我们研究了节点邻域标签分布在标签噪声影响下如何变化。我们从数学上推导出：标签噪声会平滑这种分布，从而固有地增加其熵，并严重降低类间可区分性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了留一熵节点筛选（LENS），这是一个端到端的框架，通过测量移除特定节点后邻域熵的减少程度来识别噪声节点。LENS还进一步引入了重标记机制……
tldr: 本文提出LENS框架，通过测量移除节点后邻域熵的变化来识别图数据中的噪声标签节点，并结合重标记机制，提升了图卷积网络在标签噪声下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LENS, an end-to-end framework that identifies noisy nodes in graph data by measuring the reduction in neighborhood entropy upon node removal, and incorporates a relabeling mechanism to enhance the robustness of GCNs against label noise.
